description: This Java source file defines an integration test class 'CredentialsJmsIT' for testing a Credentials service implementation using a JMS-based client within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes setup and teardown methods, multiple test cases for error conditions, and references external classes for JMS connection, client configuration, and the Credentials client.

classes.name: CredentialsJmsIT
classes.description: An integration test class for verifying the JMS-based Credentials service implementation within Eclipse Hono. It extends CredentialsApiTests and contains test cases for error handling of credential retrieval invoked via JMS.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes the device registry, and connects to the JMS-based Hono connection before all tests.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Returns the helper object managing registry interactions.

methods.name: getJmsBasedClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a JMS-based credentials client for a given tenant.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a generic CredentialsClient for a given tenant, wrapping the JMS-based client.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Deletes temporary objects from the registry after each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Disconnects and cleans up the connection after all tests are run.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForMalformedSearchCiteria
methods.description: Test ensuring a malformed request results in a 400 Bad Request error.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForMissingSubject
methods.description: Test ensuring a request missing a subject results in a 400 Bad Request error.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForUnsupportedOperation
methods.description: Test ensuring an unsupported operation in the request results in a 400 Bad Request error.
